verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair axis for an AI app-building agent, but the evidence pack shows no CLI, API, or headless mode for Bolt.new. Its documented workflows are all browser- and chat-based (chat, code view, multiplayer). GitHub sync and the MCP connectors are adjacent integrations, not a way to run Bolt itself in automation, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
